tenses: Repeated past actions — “I used to eat.”
An ongoing past action — “I was eating.”
A completed action. Transitive verbs often take ने (ne).
A completed action relevant now — “I have eaten.”
An action already completed — “I had eaten.”
Possibility, wishes or suggestions — “if I eat…”
